title: Pisa afternoon — Il Montino late lunch + reversed city walk
subtitle: Flight lands 13:10 → train to Florence ~17:00–17:30. Bags drop at the station, pizza at 14:35, sights in reverse order finishing at the Keith Haring mural near Centrale.
excluded: Baths of Nero (Bagni di Nerone) and everything inside Piazza dei Miracoli (Tower, Duomo, Baptistery) — deliberately skipped today.

alert.title: Il Montino — check the time before you count on it
alert.text: Il Montino's own site lists Monday lunch as 12:30–15:00 (dinner reopens 19:00). Your plan-time arrival of ~14:35 leaves only 25 minutes. Call +39 050 598695 to confirm they can serve you that late. If the flight or bags run late: go straight for the pizza and drop the bags afterwards, or switch to another lunch spot (Mickey's Cecineria and Panimo are both on your list and station-side of the centre).

transfers.text: Airport → Pisa Centrale, every few minutes, ~5 min ride. Get it done by ~14:00.

Pisa Centrale → Firenze SMN, regional (Regionale) roughly every 30 min, ~50–60 min ride. Target departure 17:00–17:30; ticket inspectors on board — validate (convalida) the ticket at the yellow machines before boarding.

stops.name: Land at Galileo Galilei Airport (PSA)
stops.note: FR9924 from Eindhoven. Buffers everywhere below assume no serious delay.

stops.name: Drop luggage near the station
stops.note: Bag-drop/shuttle points around Piazza della Stazione; keep the receipt for pickup later.

stops.name: Walk to Il Montino
stops.note: Cut through the Borgo Stretto shopping street if the weather is kind.

stops.name: Pizza at Pizzeria Il Montino
stops.note: Your own pick since the first trip planning: pizza, cecina, castagnaccio, filled schiacciate. Address Via del Monte 1. See the alert card about Monday hours.

stops.name: Piazza dei Cavalieri
stops.note: The scarred-tower square, Scavi di Tut photo spot; quiet in the afternoon heat.

stops.name: Piazza delle Vettovaglie
stops.note: Old market loggia, aperitivo tables under the arcades.

stops.name: Walk along the Arno
stops.note: Lungarno Mediceo eastward — the coloured facades side; no bridges to cross, easy pace with a bag-free afternoon.

stops.name: Keith Haring — Tuttomondo mural
stops.note: On the wall of Chiesa di S. Antonio, Largo Keith Haring — painted 1983, the reason to finish the loop this side.

stops.name: Collect luggage → Centrale
stops.note: Mural to the bag-drop is under 10 min at speed.

stops.name: Train to Firenze SMN
stops.note: ~50–60 min. Then: your Monday evening (apartment ~18:00, Conad cups ~19:00, Il Santo Vino sfuso before 20:00) is already on the journal grid.
